audit.normalization: lowercase; characters outside [a-z0-9] separate words; word 13-grams within each text

phases.method: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated/reserved after reset_peak_memory_stats at each phase start; host RSS sampled by psutil every interval and at phase boundaries; cpu_peak_rss_gib is ru_maxrss

teacher_storage.layout: top-K values bf16 + ids int32 + tail log-mass fp32

fit_extension.rule: flipquant calibration_sets_extended's _stream_windows (seed SEED + 2 = 20260930) on the paper record's streams, on top of the paper fit set; skipping the paper fit, development and published C4 documents

data.extension_rule: flipquant calibration_sets_extended's _stream_windows (seed SEED + 2 = 20260930) on the paper record's streams, on top of the paper fit set; skipping the paper fit, development and published C4 documents

gpus: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
